name: Burrow of the Fallen Bear
source:
The Burrow of the Fallen Bear's seal is getting weaker and adventurers from the Furland Kingdom are coming to explore the house of one of the most fearful and violent assailants of the story. Now, Krile, a young adventurer, will live his first adventure to show everyone why he should be chosen to save the Furry Heroes.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1949440/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
堕落之熊洞穴的封印越来越弱，来自弗兰王国的冒险家们正前来探索故事中最可怕、最暴力的袭击者之一的房子。现在，年轻的冒险家克莱尔将进行他的第一次冒险，向大家展示为什么他应该被选来拯救毛茸茸的英雄。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1949440/]Steam[/url]]
